dropcontrol.options.subtitle: Select the global options you want to enable.
dropcontrol.options.constant_threat.desc: Reduces the patrol interval from 12,000 to 800 ticks (10 minutes to 40 seconds) and its variation from 1,200 to 80 ticks (1 minute to 4 seconds), retaining all other vanilla spawning conditions. Doubles damage dealt directly by raiders. Captains outside raids that would already drop 1 Ominous Bottle instead drop 2, each with an independent Bad Omen level from I to V.
dropcontrol.options.parked_saddled_horse: Immobilizes mounts from the horse family while they are saddled and have no passenger. Normal movement returns when they receive a passenger or lose their saddle.
dropcontrol.options.rabbits_avoid_fences: Prevents a rabbit from jumping when a fence in the vanilla #minecraft:fences tag is ahead of its movement, up to 1.35 blocks forward and 0.8 blocks to either side. The search covers a 5 × 5 block horizontal area and 2 vertical levels, from the current Y to the block below; detecting a fence cancels the jump and stops navigation.
dropcontrol.options.endermen_dont_pick_u: Prevents endermen from starting the action of picking up blocks from the world. Blocks already being carried remain with the enderman and can still be placed normally.
dropcontrol.options.chestplate_elytra_sw: Switches between the equipped chestplate and an elytra from the inventory when Grave Accent, the key before 1, is pressed. If an elytra is equipped, it switches to a chestplate. When several items of the required type are available, it uses the one with the least remaining durability.
dropcontrol.options.pause_when_mouse_idl: Opens the pause menu and stops the world after 15 seconds without mouse movement. Works only in singleplayer worlds that are not open to LAN and only while the Minecraft window is focused.
dropcontrol.options.exact_horse_health.d: Adds the horse's current and maximum health in health points to the Jade tooltip below its speed, rounded to two decimal places. The option can be configured without Jade, but the information only appears when Jade is installed.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.dropcontrol: Control Minecraft drops through a direct, vanilla-inspired interface.
